answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A ledge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the terrace of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work. The garden of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
